title: research: speed up the complete selected P104 replay by 2.73x
body:
The complete selected P104 replay spends most of its time in literal Gaussian state evaluation. This opt-in package uses the archived exact quadratic-state engine at the two state interfaces and keeps every original scalar, native, physical-caller, invoice, compiler and outer check. On this macOS arm64 host, three alternating fresh runs per engine reduce the median from **269.00s to 98.37s (2.73×)**. Every full scientific stdout hash agrees. The ranges are 264.33–305.90s and 80.89–175.99s; this is a local verification speedup, not a physical multiplier speedup.

- Exact source binding preserves the selected WORD and complete RESULT, all 13 helper cuts, independent input rows, reverse columns, native phases and original rejection controls. All 13 source assertions remain explicit failures under optimized Python.
- A fresh full replay collects all 17,651 distinct state inputs. Both original literal interpreters independently match all 9,037,312 amplitude entries per interpreter, including zeros and denominators.
- The bounded cache holds immutable state signatures keyed by the complete typed input. Controls cover changed inputs, numeric aliases, mutable outputs, capacity and eviction. Three omitted proof checks and three corrupted algorithm/word/compiler inputs reject. No scientific acceptance receipt is cached.
- The committed export passes both registered commands with Python 3.12.14 under `-I -O -B`, empty PATH, no Git and read-only files. All exported bytes and modes stay unchanged. The normal author-side full replay, independent cross-check and six-process benchmark also pass.

[Package](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68/research/selected-quadratic-replay), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68/research/selected-quadratic-replay/PROOF.md), [measurements](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68/research/selected-quadratic-replay/BENCHMARK.json), [independent trace](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68/research/selected-quadratic-replay/CROSS.json), [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68/research/selected-quadratic-replay/VALIDATION.md), [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5748).

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-quadratic-replay`. The two registered checks run serially and include extra literal audit work; no 2.73× speedup is claimed for that larger audit. The benchmark measures the unchanged complete selected scientific checks and is a separate six-process command in the README.

This preserves the conditional κ = .00310045 and its five assumptions. It does not change the selected record or official reproduction command. Linux timing, independent human review and proof-kernel acceptance are unrun. The checkout is shallow, so the optional full-history ancestry preflight is unavailable; all 31 source bytes and blobs, committed export and Git-free replay are checked.

Base 553d26d796fde9871ff2661a49ac7732e945410f; frozen priority-7 card, refreshed against priority 8 before submission. Credit the exact PR5704 engine, selected PR5599 construction and all retained native/controller/compiler and classical stabilizer sources in [NOTICE](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68/research/selected-quadratic-replay/NOTICE). The new work is the integration, controls, full-input comparison and measurements. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
